basics.name: Maya Chen
basics.label: Software Engineer
basics.summary: Computer science student with internship experience in full-stack web development, a background in support and operations roles, and a steady interest in data visualization and accessible interface design.

work.name: Orbit Labs
work.summary: Twelve-week internship on the internal tooling team, working across a React front end and a TypeScript service layer.
highlights: Built React dashboard components used by an internal operations team to review customer event data.
Added API validation and error handling to a TypeScript service, reducing malformed requests during testing.
Wrote unit tests and participated in weekly code reviews with a five-person engineering team.

work.name: Campus Technology Center
highlights: Troubleshoot classroom computers, projectors, printers, account access, and common network issues.
Document recurring support problems and maintain setup guides for student employees.
Assist 20-40 students and faculty members during a typical weekly shift schedule.

work.name: Redwood Community Market
highlights: Handled checkout, restocking, online pickup orders, and closing procedures in a fast-paced neighborhood store.
Trained three new team members on register procedures and inventory routines.

projects.name: Transit Delay Explorer
projects.description: A web app that visualizes fictional transit delay data by route, station, and hour.
highlights: Modeled 1.2M synthetic trip records in PostgreSQL and exposed them through a small Express API.
Designed responsive filtering controls and keyboard-accessible navigation.
Documented the data schema and wrote a contributor setup guide.

projects.name: Study Buddy CLI
highlights: Built a Java command-line study tracker with spaced-review reminders, CSV export, and basic statistics.
Practiced interfaces, collections, exception handling, file I/O, and unit testing.

projects.name: Ferry Schedule Scraper
projects.description: A scheduled scraper that collects published ferry timetables and flags schedule changes week over week.
highlights: Normalized inconsistent timetable formats into a single SQLite schema.

awards.title: First Place, Bay Area Collegiate Hackathon
awards.summary: Awarded to a four-person team for an accessibility-focused campus navigation prototype built in 36 hours.

awards.title: Undergraduate Research Travel Grant
awards.awarder: Pacific State University College of Engineering

awards.title: Outstanding Student Employee of the Year

publications.name: Color Choice and Chart Legibility in Student Dashboards
publications.summary: A small study comparing comprehension rates across four categorical palettes used in student-built dashboards.

publications.name: Notes on Teaching Git to First-Year Students

volunteer.summary: Elected to the student chapter board for the 2024-2026 terms.
highlights: Help organize technical workshops, alumni panels, and beginner-friendly coding events.
Grew average workshop attendance from roughly 15 to 40 students over two semesters.
Sorted donations and assembled weekly grocery boxes for community distribution.

references.name: Dr. Priya Raman
references.reference: Maya was among the most dependable students in my database systems course and carried that same care into her capstone work.

references.name: Daniel Okafor
references.reference: Maya shipped production dashboard work during a twelve-week internship and asked exactly the right questions in code review.
